legend_bar.note: The 'metres' diverging ramp under the title block. Bar bounds were found by scanning outward from the bar core until the paper colour resumed (left border rule at x~1356, right at x~2640); the 14 swatches are equal width (91.5 px), which reproduces the plateau spacing measured off the colour profile. Each rgb below is the mean of the middle 40% of its swatch across rows 2846..2868, so JPEG ringing at the swatch seams is excluded (per-channel sd 1.0-4.3).

notes: Bands 0..5 are ocean, 6..13 are land (the legend's own 0 m break falls between band 5 and band 6). The outermost open-ended bands are given a nominal 2000 m width so a band midpoint exists for them. 'paper_rgb' is the un-inked page colour the Terraqueous oval leaves over the polar Chaos Wastes. It is NOT a classification swatch and is not in the nearest-RGB palette (changed 2026-08-04, world-map-miller-projection-canvas.md): it sits 40.6 units from band 0 while the actual polar page tone measures 42 units from it and CLOSER to band 0, so a 3-unit perturbation of either constant swung 37 points of the polar band between land and ocean. No value of that rule is right, so it was removed rather than retuned. Blank polar page is now identified SPATIALLY - it is the region reachable from the oval's north rim without crossing terrain (worldgen/ingest.polar_waste); measured on this source, 98.6% of band-0 pixels are enclosed components the flood cannot reach, so real abyssal basins are excluded by construction rather than by threshold. 'paper_elevation_m' remains live: it is the elevation that spatial rule assigns. 'paper_rgb' remains only as the record of the measurement.
